name: Hilda
source:
Hilda, like her close friend Hilbert, is a very serious student who is highly dedicated to her tasks at hand. She is also longtime friends with Cheren and Bianca, though she spends more of her time monitoring Hilbert. While she can be critical at times, Hilda cares deeply about the people in her life.

Hilda was first introduced in Pokémon Black and Pokémon White versions.
